_about: Public-domain Cardinal Désiré-Joseph Mercier (1851-1926, Archbishop of Malines, founder of the Louvain neo-Thomist school) in English for the Word Hoard: A Manual of Modern Scholastic Philosophy, tr. T. L. and S. A. Parker (2 vols, 1916-1917), his Conferences and Retreat to his priests, tr. J. M. O'Kavanagh, the Pastorals, Letters and Allocutions of 1914-1917, his psychology and logic in English, Modernism (1910), and his wartime letters, from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 32 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

mercier-manual-scholastic-1: A Manual of Modern Scholastic Philosophy, vol. I, tr. T. L. Parker and S. A. Parker (London: Kegan Paul; St. Louis: B. Herder, 1916)
mercier-manual-scholastic-2: A Manual of Modern Scholastic Philosophy, vol. II, tr. T. L. Parker and S. A. Parker (London: Kegan Paul; St. Louis: B. Herder, 1917)
mercier-conferences: Cardinal Mercier's Conferences delivered to his Seminarists at Mechlin in 1907, tr. J. M. O'Kavanagh (London: R. & T. Washbourne, 1910)
mercier-retreat: Cardinal Mercier's Retreat to his Priests, tr. J. M. O'Kavanagh (Bruges: Ch. Beyaert, 1912)
mercier-pastorals-1914-1917: Cardinal Mercier: Pastorals, Letters, Allocutions 1914-1917, sketch by Joseph F. Stillemans (New York: P. J. Kenedy & Sons, 1917)
mercier-origins-psychology: The Origins of Contemporary Psychology, tr. W. H. Mitchell (New York: P. J. Kenedy & Sons, 1918)
mercier-experimental-psychology: The Relation of Experimental Psychology to Philosophy, tr. Edmund J. Wirth (New York, Cincinnati, Chicago: Benziger Brothers, 1902)
mercier-modernism: Modernism, tr. Marian Lindsay (London: Burns and Oates, 1910)
mercier-elements-logic: Elements of Logic, third edition, tr. Ewan Macpherson (New York: Manhattanville Press, 1912)
mercier-patriotism-endurance: Pastoral Letter, Christmas 1914 (Patriotism and Endurance), official translation (London: Burns & Oates; title page undated)
mercier-shepherd-among-wolves: A Shepherd among Wolves: War-Time Letters, selected by Arthur Boutwood (London: The Faith Press; title page undated, catalogued 1919)
mercier-own-story: Cardinal Mercier's Own Story, introduction by Fernand Mayence (New York: George H. Doran; title page undated, copyright 1920)
